title: Brooke Hogan Opens Up About Devastating Turning Point With Dad Hulk Hogan - NewsBreak
text:
By Duane Beckett ,
21 hours ago Curtis Hilbun / AFF-USA.com / MEGA Brooke Hogan says her relationship with her late father, wrestling legend Hulk Hogan, was never quite the same after he slept with one of her close friends.
Brooke discussed the painful episode in an interview with Us Weekly published on September 24, 2026. She identified Hulk’s relationship with Christiane Plante as a major turning point in their father-daughter bond.
Christiane Plante was reportedly one of Brooke’s close friends and had worked with her around the time of Brooke’s 2006 album, Undiscovered. TMZ reported that Plante helped Brooke during that period before becoming involved with Hulk Hogan.
Brooke told Us Weekly that she forgave Hulk, but felt something between them changed afterward and that he no longer related to her in quite the same way. That is a pretty blunt admission for a daughter to admit about her father.
At the time, Hulk was still legally married to Brooke’s mother, Linda Hogan. E! Online reported that Plante previously said the relationship happened when Hulk and Linda privately knew their marriage was ending. Linda filed for divorce in November 2007, with the marriage later formally ending.
There is now some disagreement within the family about what happened. After Brooke’s latest comments became public, Linda denied the affair in an Instagram comment. Brooke responded by accusing her mother of “rewriting history.”
Brooke Hogan arrives to the salon in Los Angeles, CA. 18 Jan 2018. Photo credit: SUPREME/MEGA Their relationship became increasingly complicated For Brooke, the affair wasn’t presented as the only problem between her and her father.
E! Online found that she has described the relationship as becoming more complicated over time, particularly following her parents’ divorce. Brooke has also stressed that she can remember positive parts of her childhood while acknowledging the problems that developed later.
Families rarely fit neatly into good or bad boxes, particularly when years of hurt and reconciliation are involved.
Brooke eventually distanced herself from Hulk before his death. After he died in July 2025 at age 71, she explained that there hadn’t been one dramatic final fight between them. Instead, she described “respectful disagreements” that had taken an emotional toll.
One particularly difficult period came while Brooke was pregnant with twins Molly and Oliver with her husband, Steven Oleksy. She said the stress surrounding disagreements with her father contributed to her decision to step away and protect her own well-being.
How Brooke remembers Hulk Hogan Brooke hasn’t tried to erase the good parts of their relationship.
Despite describing serious problems between them, she has also spoken about loving her father and appreciating what he gave her growing up. Her account paints a much more complicated picture than the family dynamic viewers once saw on Hogan Knows Best.
In Brooke’s telling, forgiveness happened, but the repair was harder.
Her father’s relationship with one of her friends didn’t completely destroy their bond, but she believes it changed something fundamental between them. Years of additional family tension followed, and the relationship never fully recovered before Hulk Hogan’s death.
